sources.name: OPRA
sources.scope: Official OPRA runtime/database feeds used by the existing app
sources.cursor_strategy: source fingerprint and upstream revision metadata

sources.name: AutoEq
sources.scope: Structured parametric EQ results with measurement and target provenance
sources.cursor_strategy: repository commit and file content hash
sources.license_notes: AutoEq software is MIT licensed, while measurements originate from multiple third-party sources. EQ Library retains measurement/creator provenance and does not treat the software license as blanket permission for raw third-party measurement redistribution.

sources.name: oratory1990
sources.scope: Author-created EQ presets and measurement-linked revisions
sources.cursor_strategy: source update timestamp and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: Creator-authored presets remain distinct from AutoEq results derived from oratory1990 measurements. Publication requires explicit source/redistribution qualification; otherwise retain link-only provenance.

sources.name: Squiglink-compatible sources
sources.scope: Public structured measurement/target data where source terms permit use
sources.license_notes: Squiglink server/tooling is permissively licensed, but hosted measurement/database rights can be creator-specific. The v0.3 adapter discovers structured metadata only and never makes measurement records publication-eligible until source-specific rights and attribution are qualified.

sources.name: Reddit audio communities
sources.scope: Public structured PEQ posts and original preset links

sources.name: Head-Fi
sources.scope: Public headphone/model EQ discussions containing structured PEQ settings

sources.name: Audio Science Review
sources.scope: Public headphone/IEM threads with structured PEQ settings

sources.name: The HEADPHONE Community
sources.scope: Public creator/community EQ discussions with original attribution

sources.name: Public GitHub repositories and Gists
sources.scope: Licensed structured EQ datasets and original preset repositories
sources.cursor_strategy: repository commit SHA and file content hash
sources.license_notes: Discovery emits review-only candidates. A matching public file is never published until originality, repository/file licensing, creator attribution, headphone identity, parse validity and canonical dedupe are qualified.

sources.name: Topping Community
sources.scope: Public official and community tuning resources where terms allow
